title: Maximum Gap Between Stations
statement: Given a string skill of worker skills and a string station of station skills, every worker must be given a distinct station carrying the same letter, and the chosen station indices must strictly increase in worker order - so the assignment is exactly an embedding of skill as a subsequence of station. The gap of an assignment is the largest difference between the station indices of two consecutive workers, and is 0 when there is only one worker. Return the maximum gap achievable over all valid assignments.
